after.summary: Generate content using a Gemini-compatible AIsa model
after.description:
Gemini-compatible Generate Content API: Generate content using a Gemini-compatible AIsa model.

Required inputs:
- path: `model`: The AIsa model ID to use, for example: gemini-3.5-flash.
- JSON body: `contents`: Content of the conversation, required.

Key optional inputs:
- JSON body: `cachedContent`: Optional cached content ID.
- JSON body: `generationConfig` (object).
- JSON body: `safetySettings` (array).
- JSON body: `systemInstruction` (object).
- JSON body: `toolConfig`: Optional tool configuration.

Declared response fields include `candidates`, `modelVersion`, `responseId`, `usageMetadata`.
